rtr_listen_addr.description: IP address the RTR server binds to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces, '127.0.0.1' for localhost only).

rtr_listen_port.description: TCP port the RTR server listens on (standard: 3323).

enable_rtr.description: Whether to enable the RTR server. Set to false to run validation-only mode.

max_clients.description: Maximum concurrent RTR client connections allowed.

poll_interval.description: Time in seconds between successive RPKI validation runs (e.g., 3600 = every hour).

max_retries.description: Number of retries for fetching a repository before marking it unreachable.

request_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for HTTP(S) requests to RPKI repositories.

local_cache_dir.description: Absolute path to the directory where validated RPKI data is cached.

ca_cert_bundle.description: Optional path to a CA certificate bundle for validating TLS connections to repositories. Leave empty to use system defaults.

repositories.description: List of RPKI repositories to validate. Each entry includes a URI and optional settings.

headers.description: Optional HTTP headers to send with requests to this repository (e.g., for authentication).

enabled.description: Whether to fetch and validate this repository.

log_level.description: Minimum log level to record. Choices: debug, info, warn, error, critical.

log_format.description: Format of log output: human-readable 'text' or machine-processable 'json'.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Use '-' to log to standard error.
